name: Ybug API
description: Ybug API specification for user, team, project and feedback management endpoints. > **⚠️ Availability:** The API is currently limited to Company and Enterprise plan customers. ### Base url ``` https://api.ybug.io ``` ### Authentication All requests must be authenticated using a **Bearer Token** passed in the `Authorization` header. ``` Authorization: Bearer ``` ### Getting Your API Token To generate your personal API token, log in to your Ybug Dashboard and navigate to the Profile settings section: Ybug Dashboard. Click the "Generate token" button to create and view your token. ### Error Handling We utilize **Standardized HTTP Status Codes** and return **structured JSON error bodies** to ensure predictable and full error handling across all endpoints. | Status | Meaning | Typical Cause | | ------ | ------- | ------------- | | 400 Bad Request | The request payload or query parameters are invalid. | Validation errors, missing required fields, malformed JSON. | | 401 Unauthorized | The request lacks valid authentication credentials. | Missing or expired bearer token. | | 403 Forbidden | The authenticated token cannot access the resource. | Insufficient permissions, plan limitations. | | 404 Not Found | The requested resource does not exist. | Incorrect IDs or deleted resources. | | 429 Too Many Requests | The client exceeded the rate limit. | More than 100 requests per minute. | | 500 Internal Server Error | An unexpected error occurred on the server. | Transient server issues; retry with backoff. | ### Rate Limits The current global rate limit is **100 requests per minute (RPM)** per authenticated client. Exceeding this limit will result in an **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests** response.
